assessor: writer self-assessment; independent integrator review pending
notes: This feature is an internal implementation migration (libxml2 to the Rust xml crate) with feature type 'No developer-visible change'. The developer-facing surface is therefore the migration/behavior contract: which parsing scenarios changed engines, the parser-selection algorithm, the observable error-reporting deltas, the measured performance envelope, and the test/bisect/report path. No API items are inventoried because none exist — DOMParser and XMLHttpRequest.responseXML keep their unchanged, MDN-documented contracts. The intent's 'two or three compatibility issues ... identified during the experiment phase' are not individually enumerated in any public source; the page preserves that ambiguity verbatim rather than inventing specifics.

errors.rationale: The bisect/report contract is a diagnostic procedure, not an executable API: toggling a Blink runtime feature via the documented --enable-blink-features / --disable-blink-features switches has no author-visible error surface of its own (RuntimeEnabledFeatures.md defines no error behavior for the switches), and the failure mode being diagnosed — a parse difference — is documented as this feature's error-reporting contract in #error-reporting.
